title: Pluto’s Discoverer Flew Past It After His Death

author: Sideprojects
description:
Deep in Mexico's Calakmul Biosphere Reserve, archaeologists discovered Minanbé, an untouched Maya city hidden for over a millennium. Using lidar technology and machete-cut trails, they found pyramids, plazas, and fourteen carved monuments dating to roughly AD 680-849. The site remains unlooted, but its remote location makes full excavation nearly impossible.
